To implement pagination with Kaminari, ensure the gem is installed and then update your controller and view as follows. ### 1. Implementation ```ruby # app/controllers/articles_controller.rb class ArticlesController < ApplicationController def index # Use .page() and .per(10) provided by Kaminari @articles = Article.page(params[:page]).per(10) end end ``` ### 2. View Helper (Optional but recommended) To display the "Next" and "Previous" links in your view: ```erb <%# app/views/articles/index.html.erb %>

Articles

<% @articles.each do |article| %> <% end %>
<%= article.title %>
<%= paginate_arrows @articles %>
``` ### Prerequisites Ensure your `Gemfile` includes the gem and you have run `bundle install`: ```ruby # Gemfile gem 'kaminari' ``` **Note:** If you are using a custom scope or join, ensure you call `.page` on the ActiveRecord Relation object (e.g., `@articles = Article.published.page(params[:page]).per(10)`).
